paper.title: Creative Momentum Transfer: How Timing and Labeling of AI Suggestions Shape Iterative Human Ideation
paper.venue: Proceedings of the Thirty-Fourth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-25)
paper.pdf_filename: Fan Liu Pan Huang (2025) - Creative Momentum Transfer.pdf
paper.version_read: Published IJCAI-25 proceedings paper, Special Track on Human-Centred AI, printed pages 10280-10288 (PDF pages 1-9); no separate revision date stated.
paper.one_line_finding: Final expert-rated creativity was higher in Early-AI-Labeled (M = 6.01, SD = 0.48) than Control (M = 4.94), with an omnibus condition effect of F(4, 237) = 37.54, p < .001, partial eta-squared = .38 (PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 4.1).
paper.shared_samples: No reuse of participants from another paper is stated. The qualitative interviews follow the main experiment and use a subset of its participants. Whether the stimulus pilot overlapped with the main sample is not stated.

studies.label: Main five-condition, two-round plastic-pollution ideation experiment

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.1; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.6 and 4.1
counts_source.quote: A total of 254 adult participants were initially enrolled, and seven were removed for failing attention checks or offering cursory responses, resulting in a final sample size of 247.

arms.name: Control
arms.description: No external suggestions in either round. Section 3.1 reports n = 50 after the seven stated exclusions; its relation to the later outlier/incomplete-response screening is unresolved (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.1; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 3.6).

arms.name: Early-AI-Labeled
arms.description: GPT-4 suggestions introduced in Round 1 under the heading AI-generated ideas, with bold text and an icon. No new external inputs in Round 2; continued access to the original suggestions is unspecified. Section 3.1 reports n = 49 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

arms.name: Early-AI-Unlabeled
arms.description: The same GPT-4 suggestions introduced in Round 1 under Ideas from others, without explicit AI attribution. No new external inputs in Round 2; continued access is unspecified. Section 3.1 reports n = 49 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

arms.name: Late-AI-Labeled
arms.description: Unassisted Round 1 followed by GPT-4 suggestions at the start of Round 2, explicitly headed AI-generated ideas. Section 3.1 reports n = 50 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

arms.name: Late-AI-Unlabeled
arms.description: Unassisted Round 1 followed by the same GPT-4 suggestions at the start of Round 2 under Ideas from others. Section 3.1 reports n = 49 before any unquantified additional screening (PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Sections 3.1 and 3.3-3.4; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.4 and 3.6).

studies.task: Propose innovative, feasible community solutions for reducing urban plastic pollution, then refine, expand, combine, or develop new solutions in the next round.

ai_tool.name: GPT-4
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.3: pre-generated GPT-4 suggestions, lightly edited after pilot feedback; no model version or release year is stated

Final ideas were assessed by three domain experts using seven-point novelty, usefulness and originality scales under a modified Consensual Assessment Technique. The overall-score formula, rater/idea aggregation and separate Round 1 rating procedure are unspecified. PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 3.5; PDF p. 5 (printed p. 10284), Section 4.4.

not_extracted.reason: Not a two-arm estimate. PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 4.1: "F(4, 237) = 85.53, p < .001, η2 = .59," This outcome is labeled eta-squared, without the word partial in this result; it is not substituted for a pairwise effect.

not_extracted.what: S1-O1: within-arm changes in creativity from Round 1 to Round 2
not_extracted.reason: Fixed round order, not randomized within-person assistance order and not an AI-versus-comparison-arm effect. It reports Early-AI-Labeled change +0.17 and Control change +0.14. Figure 2e under the shared legend instead depicts the steepest creativity trajectory for Early-AI-Labeled; do not reassign the prose statistics or compute a difference in changes.

not_extracted.reason: Fixed-order within-person change rather than randomized order or a two-arm contrast. not_extracted.what: S1-O1 and S1-O5: Round 1 levels in Figure 2e
not_extracted.reason: Only unnumbered arm trajectories are plotted, without a separate reported first-round pairwise contrast or printed first-round arm statistic. not_extracted.reason: The screening map summarizes timing comparisons across named arms. Section 4.1 and Figure 2a (PDF pp. 4-5, printed pp. 10283-10284) report group orderings and arm-specific displays; Section 4.4 (PDF p. 5, printed p. 10284) describes between-condition changes. No pooled timing estimate or pooled arm mean is identified. The relevant arm pairs are retained individually, including creativity-change comparisons. No additional combined-arm record, mean, count or effect is constructed.

open_items: Original randomized counts and timing of the seven stated exclusions are unconfirmed. Section 3.1 reports 254 enrolled and 247 after those exclusions, with arm counts 50/49/49/50/49; Section 3.6 additionally removes outliers and incomplete responses without counts. Repeated F(4, 237) tests do not establish the stated five-arm denominators. No headcount is inferred from df and no arm counts are summed.

Whether Early-AI suggestions remained accessible in Round 2 is unreported. Restored Early-AI treatment-versus-Control and early-only semantic-distance labeling records, and the pooled labeling comparison, have question and outcome_with_ai set to null pending clarification. These reported output contrasts remain included because both with_ai and after_ai are in scope. Late-AI treatment records, including comparisons with an Early-AI comparator, retain confirmed with_ai production without asserting the comparator retained or lost access.

Final creativity and semantic-distance means for Late-AI-Labeled, Late-AI-Unlabeled and Early-AI-Unlabeled are not numerically printed. Only the Early-AI-Labeled creativity SD is printed. Timing-specific final-level pairwise effects and numerical uncertainty are absent. The restored pooled labeling comparison prints both semantic-distance means, t, a p bound and d, but no arm SDs, test df, effect standardizer, SE or interval bounds.

The paper does not define the asterisk thresholds in Figure 2a or numerically label its error bars. The Figure 2 caption identifies shaded 95% confidence intervals, without numerical bounds; this does not provide contrast-specific uncertainty.
The overall-creativity composite formula, averaging across experts and ideas, and the Round 1 rating procedure are unreported.

The semantic-distance transformation from cosine similarity and the aggregation across GPT-4 suggestions are not specified. This outcome compares a participant with AI exemplars, not different people.

Section 4.4 does not identify which Late-AI arm or aggregation produced its maximum creativity gain and semantic-distance change, and the creativity attribution conflicts with Figure 2e. The prose reports larger Late-AI gains than Early-AI or Control but provides no numerical between-arm change effect or uncertainty and no Late-AI treatment-arm mean changes that can be assigned to the retained comparisons. The printed Early-AI-Labeled and Control changes are retained in the restored Early-AI comparisons; the Early-AI-Unlabeled change remains unreported.
Recruitment frame, population category, country and physical administration setting are unreported. Web-platform delivery alone does not establish an online-panel RCT; design_class uses unstated_rct.
GPT-4 version/release year, preregistration and a primary outcome are not stated. The model year remains null.
Pilot counted units, overlap with the main sample and the source of the AI-stimulus prerating mean are unspecified. No external sample reuse is stated.
